core_idea: The Pequod Harpooneer Heathcliff is a Tank — **Bleed** focus.
playstyle_guide:
- Skills check **6+ Bleed** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Front-load **+5 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Hold S3 for when At 3+ Envy Reson. is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Stalk Prey** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits

**S2 — Snagharpoon** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits

**S3 — Sever Knot** (BP 4, CP +3, x4): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low / High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: At 3+ Envy Reson., Clash Power +1 | At 4+ Envy Reson., Coin Power +1.
- Inflict 1 Bleed; [On Hit] At 50%- HP, inflict 1 Bleed
- +30% Damage on Critical Hit

Combat passive — **Mutilated Tattoos**: Gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up next turn every time an ally (including this unit) is attacked. Gain 2 of each instead if….
  - Deal more damage the less HP this unit has.
  - Deal +1% damage for every 1% missing HP.

Combat passive — **Desperation**: 1 ally with the highest max HP deals more Pierce Damage at less HP.
  - Deal +0.3% damage for every 1% missing HP (Max 30%).

Defense skill — **Counter: Payback**: [On Use] Gain +5 Aggro to this Skill Slot next turn.
  - [Combat Start] Gain Defense Level Up for every Poise on self (Max 10).
